# Declaration target controls

Authored controls for the pinned Bend parser at
`e6676b080f25b1bc1bf5b5b7d7a17e22f8022599`. The first two positive manifest entries
reuse the earlier authored alias/shadow reproducers byte-for-byte; they are not
upstream inventory fixtures. `completed` exercises a law followed by its definition;
`observe` makes both the imported and newly qualified values observable. `open`
keeps resolved-law completion and repeated import aliases. `specialization` exercises
an ordinary template with a Base-shadowing declaration spelling. `io` adds native
execution observations through wrappers without editing the original reproducers.

The eight rejection goldens come from pinned upstream checking. They cover qualified
duplicates, imported source locations, wrong completion headers, type/template
conflicts, an invalid new body and a still-unfilled local law. No negative emits an
executable. `foreign` is a load/check-only boundary: its inert sidecar does not
qualify foreign execution or host ABI support. Strict proof exclusions remain.

Missing-parenthesis diagnostic order, Base-marked open-law completion, and all
previously unresolved semantic/oracle cases are outside this bounded correction.
